name: Avocado Tomato Salad with Walnut, Olive & Sun-Dried Tomato Tapenade
instructions: Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
Mince walnuts, olives, and sun-dried tomatoes. Add all three to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine the tapenade. Set aside.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin pieces.
To serve, divide tomato and avocado slices between plates, then spoon tapenade over top. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
